raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Gave an incorrect mass for the neutron (~8.5e-32 kg) and concluded it is the least massive. In reality, the electron (≈9.11e-31 kg) has the least mass; the neutron is ≈1.675e-27 kg (slightly heavier than the proton), and any nucleus is heavier still.
